description: Item schema for ΛLingua Experiment One (acquisition). Extends benchmark-v0 canonical_state unchanged.

files.acquisition-train.jsonl: Stage 2 corrective exercises (TR01-TR09). Teaching only; never examined.
files.exam-skeletons.json: 24 matched epistemic skeletons (K01-K24), each with 5 disjoint content fillers; source of the checkpoint forms.
files.unseen-exam-X0.jsonl: Checkpoint C0 form (X0-01..X0-24); also the form for every compression condition.
files.transfer-exam.jsonl: Stage 4 cross-domain transfer (TI/TS/TL 01-08): 8 isomorphic skeletons x 3 domains.

item_fields.checkpoint: unseen only: C0-C4 (the only checkpoint at which the item is administered)
item_fields.terms: sorted list of term identifiers (assertions, unknowns, hypotheses) given to the model; evidence identifiers appear verbatim in input and are not listed

canonical_state.support_edges: array of [assertion, evidence] directed provenance edges

item_fields.canonical_lambda: deterministic rendering: per assertion (in order) one line per edge 'φ:A ∵ ε:E' or 'φ:A'; then standalone evidence 'ε:E'; then '?:U'; then 'ĥ:H'
item_fields.adversarial: null | plausible_cause | orphan_evidence | unsupported_assertion | obvious_hypothesis | lexical_trap | crossed_evidence_late_qualifier
item_fields.adversarial_taught_in_curriculum: present when adversarial is non-null: whether a training item with the same trap type exists
item_fields.cue_set: taught = epistemic cue phrasing used in demonstrations/training; novel = phrasing never used in teaching material
item_fields.skeleton: unseen: K01-K24 (shared across forms X0-X4); transfer: S1-S8 (shared across domains)

form_rules: Item Xk-nn = skeleton Knn rendered with filler k by tools/build_exam_forms.py; files must equal a fresh render.
Forms share frames and structure; they share no term identifier, evidence identifier, input, or 4-word content sequence.
authoring_conventions: '<EVIDENCE> shows that X', 'X, as recorded in <EVIDENCE>', 'X ... documented in <EVIDENCE>' => φ:X ∵ ε:EVIDENCE.
'X; no evidence item is cited for this' => φ:X with no support edge.
'<EVIDENCE>, a ..., is on file; no finding is drawn from it' or '... was also collected but supports none of these statements' => standalone ε:EVIDENCE.
'Whether X is unknown', 'It has not been determined whether X', 'remains an open question', 'No one has established whether X' => ?:X.
'X has been put forward as a cause', 'X has been suggested ...', 'One working theory is X', 'under consideration, neither confirmed', 'or so it has been suggested; this is not confirmed' => ĥ:X.
Every source state is fully representable in ΛLingua v0; no item requires support edges on hypotheses or unknowns.
scoring_principles: Do not upgrade hypotheses or unknowns into assertions.
